summary.text: Twin son of Miletus and brother of Byblis — when his sister's letters confessed a love no kinship should bear, he fled their Milesian home and wandered through Caria and Lycia until he escaped her pursuit forever.

story.text: Cyane daughter of the Maeander bore Miletus the twins Byblis and Caunus, children of surpassing beauty. When a servant read Byblis' confession aloud by mistake, Caunus fled in horror, renouncing kinship and homeland; he would not read her further letters.

Through Caria and Lycia the youth outran his sister's frenzy — past Cragus, Lymira, the Xanthus, Bubassus, and the ridge of Chimaera — until he vanished into lands she could not enter, leaving Byblis to become the weeping spring of Miletus.
